issues.legal_issue: An assignment of an interest in immovable property made in breach of a court order restraining transfers during a pending suit cannot support the assignee’s impleadment in that suit.
material_facts: A suit for partition of family property remained pending after a preliminary decree had allocated a share to one of the parties.
While proceedings toward a final decree were pending, the trial court ordered the parties not to alienate or transfer any part of the property involved in the suit.
A party assigned his rights under the preliminary decree after the restraint order was made.
The assignees sought impleadment in the pending suit on the basis of that assignment, and the lower courts allowed their application.
issues.conclusion: The assignment was to be treated as not having taken place for purposes of the suit, so the assignees could not be impleaded on its basis. The orders allowing impleadment were set aside and the application was rejected.
issues.legal_principle: An assignment of a decree relating to immovable property is an assignment of property and falls within an order restraining alienation or transfer of the property. When a court has ordered that a particular state of affairs be maintained while a suit is pending, it may treat a transfer made in defiance of that order as having not taken place for purposes of the proceedings, to prevent defeat of justice and public policy. Under Order 22 Rule 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure, the assignees could not be impleaded on the basis of an assignment that the court was entitled to disregard. The Court did not rely on earlier cases and did not decide the separate question of lis pendens.

rule.if: pending_suit_impleadment_request and restraint_order_covers_suit_property and assignment_made_during_restraint and impleadment_based_on_assignment

predicates.pending_suit_impleadment_request: A request is made to join an assignee as a party to a pending suit.
predicates.restraint_order_covers_suit_property: The court has ordered that property involved in the pending suit must not be transferred.
predicates.assignment_made_during_restraint: A party assigns an interest in the suit property while the court’s restraint order is in force.
predicates.impleadment_based_on_assignment: The proposed party relies on that assignment as the basis for being joined in the suit.

issues.definition: When an assignee seeks to join a pending suit based on an assignment made in breach of a court order protecting the property in dispute, the assignee is not joined as a party.
